$comment: Hard marginal gzip KiB ceilings for splitting-aware production ESM. Each route adds one anchored component to the representative shell in $baseline. Initial bytes include only the entry and transitively static chunks; dynamic chunks remain covered by total-cost budgets. Preserve passing canaries, shell imports and optional-peer exclusions. Reviewed increases use exact measurements or the next 64-byte boundary, with at most 4% headroom. Shared modal ordering and reconnect handling measure 19,848 initial marginal gzip bytes for tour; only its exceeded ceiling advances to 19,904 bytes. The shared visually hidden form-control label option advances only the exceeded marginal ceilings to the next 64-byte boundary. Script-aware locale lookup and the 80-locale loader table measure 1,005 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader, and 29,323 and 9,928 marginal bytes for model-select and mention-popover; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Named anchors for href menu items measure 18,204 initial marginal gzip bytes for menu; only its ceiling advances to 18,240 bytes. Build-time optional-peer import guards measure 1,083 initial route gzip bytes for locale-loader and 42,753 marginal bytes for date-input; only those exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Upgrading scoped elements after adoption, for native scoped registries in iframe and detached documents, advances only the exceeded dist/utilities/scoped-registry-loader.js route ceiling to the next 64-byte boundary above its reviewed 11,470-byte measurement. Active token-provider validation measures 30,915 marginal gzip bytes for voice-picker; only that exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, 30,976 bytes. Releasing deferred overlay subscriptions disposed during setup measures 18,113 initial marginal gzip bytes for popover and 7,107 for citation-badge; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 18,176 and 7,168 bytes. Locale-picker positioning-failure recovery measures 30,044 initial marginal gzip bytes; only its exceeded ceiling advances to 30,080 bytes. This release measures 29,395 initial marginal gzip bytes for model-select, 27,660 for time-input and 37,383 for select; only these exceeded ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary, 29,440, 27,712 and 37,440 bytes. Icon load ownership and active-failure handling change shared-shell compression: popup measures 4,804 initial marginal gzip bytes and export-button 14,594. Only these exceeded ceilings advance to 4,864 and 14,656 bytes, their next 64-byte boundaries; the representative shell, optional-peer exclusions and all passing canaries remain unchanged. Control theming and lifecycle repairs advance only the exceeded initial ceilings to the next 64-byte boundaries above their measurements. The shared component helpers and related repairs measure 8,164 initial marginal gzip bytes for tool-call-chip, 4,735 for usage-badge, 43,073 for date-input, 18,663 for menu, 18,548 for popover, 16,505 for tooltip, 7,227 for citation-badge, 6,628 for entity-chip, 15,036 for export-button, 10,002 for mention-popover, and 20,077 for tour. Each exceeded ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary.
